summary_en: Five papers. Prioritize kiwifruit 3D multi-omics and the CrJAG mechanism; focus on motif grammar in PEAgent.

summary: 本期聚焦辣椒及茄科作物在表观遗传调控、果实发育以及多组学分析方面的最新进展，涵盖DNA甲基化、组蛋白修饰、染色质可及性和转录因子网络。重点审视了辣椒AP2/ERF家族转录因子系统鉴定与生物学功能、辣椒抗寒机制的多组学解析及精准育种策略，以及果实专一启动子的调控特点和应用前景。此外，纳入了甘菊中ABA调控盐胁迫的表观遗传机制研究，为辣椒和茄科作物环境适应和抗逆提供启示。选文还包含了组学资源构建和表观调控综述，为辣椒22组织图谱及果实成熟转录调控网络研究提供参考。
summary_en: This issue focuses on recent advances in epigenetic regulation, fruit development, and multi-omics in Capsicum and Solanaceae crops, covering DNA methylation, histone modifications, chromatin accessibility, and transcription factor networks. It highlights the genome-wide identification and functional analysis of the AP2/ERF transcription factor family in chili pepper, multi-omics dissection of cold tolerance and precision breeding strategies in pepper, and the regulatory features and applications of fruit-specific promoters. Studies on ABA-mediated epigenetic modulation of salt tolerance in chrysanthemum provide insights into environmental adaptation in Solanaceae. The selected papers also include resource generation and comprehensive reviews on epigenetic regulation, offering valuable references for the pepper 22-tissue atlas and fruit ripening transcriptional regulatory networks.
provenance: Europe PMC; abstract-based commentary; 28-day publication/indexing lookback; full text unverified.

summary: 本期摘要聚焦辣椒及茄科植物的基因组编辑、果实发育调控及多组学研究，涵盖最新CRISPR技术在茄科真菌抗性及品质提升中的应用，辣椒抗旱生理与转录组变化，以及涉及DNA甲基化和组蛋白修饰的新进展。挑选了最新且与辣椒22组织图谱构建和转录因子网络相关联的论文，强调基因编辑和表观遗传机制的结合，助力辣椒品种改良与品质提升。
summary_en: This issue focuses on recent advances in genome editing, fruit development regulation, and multi-omics studies in pepper and Solanaceae species. It includes cutting-edge CRISPR technology applications for fungal resistance and quality improvements in Solanaceae, physiological and transcriptomic responses of chili under drought stress, and new findings on DNA methylation and histone modifications. Selected papers relate closely to the pepper 22-tissue atlas construction and fruit-ripening transcription factor networks, highlighting the integration of gene editing and epigenetic mechanisms to facilitate pepper breeding and quality enhancement.
provenance: Europe PMC; abstract-based commentary; 28-day publication/indexing lookback; full text unverified.

summary: 本期重点聚焦辣椒果实着色的转录调控与茄科作物的遗传改良：一项辣椒预印本提出DOF转录因子抑制辣椒红素积累的调控线索；补录研究报告辣椒CRK过表达与耐盐表型相关；另一项补录工作显示芒果YUCCA基因在番茄中过表达可提高耐盐、耐旱性，但伴随果实变小等代价。将这些研究用于辣椒22组织图谱时，应把组学关联、遗传干预结果和待验证的跨品种应用明确区分。
summary_en: This issue focuses on transcriptional regulation of pepper fruit coloration and genetic improvement in Solanaceae crops. A pepper preprint proposes a regulatory lead in which DOF transcription factors repress capsanthin accumulation; a backfill study reports an association between pepper CRK overexpression and salt-tolerance phenotypes; and another backfill study finds that overexpressing mango YUCCA genes in tomato improves salt and drought tolerance, but comes with costs including smaller fruit. When applying these studies to the 22-tissue pepper atlas, distinguish omics associations, genetic-intervention results, and cross-variety applications that remain to be tested.
provenance: Europe PMC; abstract-based commentary; 28-day publication/indexing lookback; full text unverified.

summary: 本期收录3篇仍在28天检索窗口内、但早于最近7天的补录文献：两篇植物单细胞表观组学与组蛋白乙酰化综述，分别可为22组织图谱的细胞类型分辨率规划及果实代谢调控假设提供方法和概念参考；另有一项柑橘CiFTIP1在番茄中过表达的开花研究，提供了可评估但尚未验证于辣椒的开花时间调控思路。摘要未提供辣椒中的同源基因、旁系同源关系或功能证据；图谱应用均属研究启示。
summary_en: This issue includes three backfill papers within the 28-day retrieval window but older than the past seven days: reviews of plant single-cell epigenomics and histone acetylation, offering methodological and conceptual reference points for cell-type resolution in the 22-tissue atlas and hypotheses about fruit-metabolism regulation; and a study of citrus CiFTIP1 overexpression in tomato, offering a flowering-time strategy to assess but not yet validated in pepper. The abstracts provide no evidence for pepper orthology, paralogy, or function; proposed atlas applications are research implications.
provenance: Europe PMC; abstract-based commentary; 28-day publication/indexing lookback; full text unverified.

summary: 本期精选4项与茄科果实性状和辣椒研究可迁移思路相关的工作，涵盖番茄果实硬度、桃果皮绿化、番茄UV-B响应及梨果香气调控。均为补录：所给记录日期早于本期最近7天；其中较早发表的研究依据记录中的近期收录信息纳入。摘要未报告辣椒验证，也没有研究直接采用辣椒22组织图谱所列的RNA-seq、ATAC-seq、CUT&Tag或WGBS组合；图谱应用均属待验证的研究启示。
summary_en: This issue selects four studies relevant to Solanaceae fruit traits and transferable ideas for pepper research, covering tomato fruit firmness, peach fruit greening, tomato UV-B responses, and pear fruit aroma regulation. All are backfill items: the dates supplied in the records precede the most recent seven days; older-published studies are included based on their recent indexing in the records. None reports validation in pepper, and none directly uses the combined RNA-seq, ATAC-seq, CUT&Tag, or WGBS design of the pepper 22-tissue atlas. Atlas applications are proposed research implications that remain to be tested.
provenance: Europe PMC; abstract-based commentary; 28-day publication/indexing lookback; full text unverified.
